subject: Pilot readiness: rapid hosted pilot — endpoint plan & rate budget
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@ellora.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellora Systems Procurement <procurement@ellora.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot readiness: rapid hosted pilot — endpoint plan & rate budget

Thanks again for the demo earlier — it was helpful to see the latency and token economics in action. A quick recap from our side and three asks so we can move to procurement: 

1) Scope: We want to run a 4-week hosted pilot (sandbox -> staging) that validates Latency < 200ms P95 for chat completions and verifies token costs on our 10M monthly token estimate. We are not ready for Dedicated yet, but we want an easy path there if needed.

2) Traffic profile (initial estimate): peak concurrency ~ 15 RTTs, steady TPS ~ 8 requests/sec, average request length ~ 120 tokens, expected embeddings workload: small (on-demand).

3) Questions / asks: 
- Can you confirm what sandbox/staging hosted endpoints you’ll provision, and whether they include streaming?
- What default rate-limits and burst behavior do you recommend for this profile?
- Any data residency or retention notes we should surface to our legal/procurement team?

We attached the recording and a draft SOW so procurement can start reviewing. Proposed kickoff target: next Monday (Nov 6). If hosted looks good, procurement will route for a standard PO + SOW.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Park
Head of Product
Ellora Systems

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (link), SOW-draft-v1.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@ellora.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ellora Systems Procurement <procurement@ellora.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness: rapid hosted pilot — endpoint plan & rate budget

Sam — great meeting, thanks for the clear profile. Quick answers and next steps below.

Sandbox/staging endpoints: We'll provision two hosted endpoints for your trial: 
- el-rapid-chat-sandbox.redwood (streaming enabled) — used for interactive UX testing
- el-rapid-batch-sandbox.redwood — for any non-stream batch/embedding work

Rate-limits & burst policy: For your profile we recommend starting with the following guardrails: 
- Per-endpoint steady TPS: 10 r/s
- Peak burst window: up to 25 r/s for 30s (auto-throttled)
- Concurrent active connections: quota of 20 sessions
These are configurable; we can loosen for short load tests. We'll document expected 429 behavior and automatic backoff guidance in the playbook.

Data residency / retention: Hosted trial will store logs and KV cache in our us-west region. We will not persist user inputs longer than 30 days for the pilot unless you request longer retention for debugging. KMS-managed encryption at rest is standard. If you need VPC or on-prem later we have a clear migration path.

Next steps (proposed): 
1) I’ll send the Hosted Quickstart Playbook (attached) with endpoint names, sample curl/SDK snippets, expected SLOs, and the initial rate policy.
2) Kickoff call: Mon Nov 6 — 10:00 AM PT — 45 min (ops + engineering) to exchange keys, map sample prompts, and confirm SOW items.
3) Procurement: Jordan to coordinate redlines with your procurement lead; Monica will own initial SLO metrics for the pilot.

If that works I’ll lock the sandbox endpoints and share temporary API keys ahead of the call.

— Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0182

Attachment: hosted-quickstart-playbook.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 10:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Ellora pilot — quick notes

Quick internal note for the record (reply-all not required):
- Hosted fits the ask and will get them up fast. Recommend the following defaults for the trial: 10 r/s steady, 25 r/s burst, 20 concurrent sessions.
- Suggest enabling prefix KV caching for the 120-token average prompt to reduce per-token spend — mention in playbook.
- Provide a fallback model that is cheaper/quantized for stress tests (to avoid SLO breaches during load tests).
- Ops preflight: network ACLs, sample payloads (we should ask for 3 representative prompts), and data retention sign-off from procurement.

I can be on Monday's kickoff for the first 30 min to confirm runtime knobs.

— Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — that looks good. Confirming: we take the hosted sandbox endpoints and the proposed rate policy for the 4-week pilot. Please go ahead and provision the keys and share the playbook.

Kickoff confirmed: Mon Nov 6, 10:00 AM PT — invite forthcoming.

Best,
